More about Plura
Made with AI Edit
Plura, formerly known as Bloom Community, is a social and dating application with a mission to foster connections through in-person events.
Founded in 2020 by Lauren (Luna) Ray Vegter, the Oakland-based company was born out of the desire to create a safe digital space for communities on the edge of culture, such as LGBTQ+, ethically non-monogamous, kink, and creative groups.
The company operates in the social networking and dating market, specifically targeting individuals seeking organic connections beyond traditional swipe-based apps. Plura's business model is centered on a mobile application available on both iOS and Android.
Revenue is generated through a premium subscription model called Plura+ or "SuperBloomer," which unlocks advanced features for dating and events, such as viewing who has liked your profile and receiving discounts on ticketed events. The app itself is free to use for discovering and adding events, as well as connecting with other users.
Plura partners with event organizers, which has reportedly led to increased ticket sales and community engagement for those organizers.
The Plura platform is designed to facilitate connections before, during, and after events.
